strategies.trigger: HTTP 403, blocked, or empty/short body from web_fetch
strategies.efficiency_gain: Avoids repeated failed fetches; enables primary-source verification

strategies.trigger: JS-heavy page or cookie wall, little useful text from fetch
strategies.tactic: Use browser_open; dismiss cookies then browser_extract_text
strategies.efficiency_gain: Gets visible content when static fetch fails

strategies.trigger: Search snippet only — no successful fetch/browser of the page
strategies.tactic: Mark claim as deels geverifieerd or niet bevestigd; do not use geverifieerd
strategies.efficiency_gain: Prevents overconfident claims without primary sources

strategies.trigger: Two consecutive empty or failed searches on the same sub-topic
strategies.tactic: Mark sub-topic as onvoldoende data and continue with main objective
strategies.efficiency_gain: Stops wasted tool calls on dead ends

strategies.trigger: Enough strong candidates with traced sources already collected
strategies.tactic: Stop extra searches; write RESEARCH_COMPLETE report
strategies.efficiency_gain: Prevents context bloat and LLM timeouts

strategies.trigger: Hard criteria from the task not yet checked on top candidates
strategies.tactic: Do targeted search/fetch per criterion on the strongest candidates only
strategies.efficiency_gain: Verifies what the user actually asked without boiling the ocean
